COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
SPA No.117 of 2022
Shri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Shri Ramesh Chandra Khulbe, J.
Mr. M.K. Goyal, learned counsel for
the appellants.
Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Deputy 
Advocate General for the State.
Issue notice.
Learned counsel for the respondent 
accepts notice.
The submission of the learned counsel 
for the appellants is that the learned 
Single Judge has heard and concluded 
that the appellant has a remedy before 
the Civil Court. He submits that in the 
light of Section 46 under the 
Administration of Evacuee Property Act, 
1950 approach to the Civil Court is 
expressly barred. He submits that the
order granting mutation against the 
appellant could be assailed in a writ￾petition to raise issues, not on merit, at 
least on the aspects of due compliance of 
the procedure established by law.
Notice is also directed to be issued to 
respondent nos.5 to 11 returnable on 
15.02.2023.
Since counter affidavit was not called 
for in the writ-proceedings, respondent 
nos.1 to 4 may file their counter affidavit 
within six weeks. Rejoinder affidavit be 
filed before the next date.
List the matter on 15.02.2023.
(R.C. Khulbe, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)
 12.09.2022
SS/RB 2
